title: AAFES Worker Survives Tsunami package
description: Package made from "AAFES Worker Survives Tsunami b-roll" in this section about AAFES store manager Annette Brueckner returning to work in Taji, Iraq after a vacation to Thailand during the tsunami last December.  Produced by Specialist Brad Richardson, American Forces Network Iraq.
